welcome.title: Aurora Glass is installed
welcome.description: Let's create your animated dashboard. In a few steps you pick its name and language, your rooms and the devices to show. Rooms, lights and sensors are found automatically from your Home Assistant areas: you only check and rename. You can change everything later from Settings → Devices & services → Aurora Glass → Configure.

user.title: Your dashboard
user.description: This name appears in the sidebar on the left.

data_description.language: Automatic follows the language of each Home Assistant user.

areas.title: Rooms
areas.description: Pick the Home Assistant areas to show as rooms ({found} are suggested: they have lights or sensors, or the name of a light points to them). On the next screens you can rename each room and check its lights and sensors. Need a room without an area? Add it below.

data_description.extra_rooms: How many rooms to add by hand, picking lights and sensors yourself.

room.title: Room {current} of {total}
room.description: Area: {area}. Give the room the name you want to see on the dashboard and check what was found.

data_description.lights: Each light becomes a button with an animated picture. Switches work too.
data_description.image: The illustration used for this room's light buttons.

lights.title: Lights without a room
lights.description: {count} lights and relays are not in any Home Assistant area. Put each one in its room below: {guessed} are already suggested from their names. Anything you leave out won't be on the dashboard (you can add it later from Configure).

data.assign_areas: Also put them in these areas in Home Assistant

data_description.assign_areas: Handy for the rest of Home Assistant too. Only for rooms that come from an area.

devices.title: Your home
devices.description: Everything is optional: leave a field empty and that part of the dashboard is hidden.

data_description.weather: Shows the outside temperature on the home screen.
data_description.power: Turns on the Energy view with live power and costs.
data_description.energy: A total energy sensor (kWh) for the 14-day history.
data_description.currency: Used for the energy costs, for example €, $ or £.

scenes.title: Quick scenes
scenes.description: What each quick scene turns on (everything else is turned off). You can also pick a Home Assistant scene or script. Leave a scene empty to hide it.

data.night_alarm: Good night also arms the alarm (night mode)
data.away_alarm: Leaving home also arms the alarm (away mode)

error.no_rooms: Pick at least one area or add a room without an area.

abort.already_configured: Aurora Glass is already set up.
abort.not_this_instance: This announcement comes from another Home Assistant.
